summary: Frontend E2E testing of 3 new features (Live Tracking, Family Invites, Admin Alerts + CSV) plus light regression. All flows PASS end-to-end against the public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Track.jsx: draw() reads mapObj.current inside a useEffect that depends on `track`, but the map-init effect uses [] deps — first draw is triggered inside then() which is fine, but if track updates before Leaflet resolves, no early re-draw is scheduled. Currently benign but could be tightened by triggering draw() when mapObj becomes ready.
Admin.jsx exportCSV: uses window URL.createObjectURL and does not call a.remove() nor append to DOM; works in Chromium but for Safari append/remove is safer.

Invite.jsx: on logged-out click of accept-invite-btn the redirect target is /login?next=/invite/<token>; verify Login.jsx honours the `next` query param (not directly tested here — optional per request).
test_credentials: Owner demo_web@safeqr.com/demo1234; Admin admin@safeqr.com/admin1234; new user registered inline (relative_<rand>@safeqr.com/demo1234).
seed_data_creation: Registered ephemeral relative_<rand>@safeqr.com; accepted invite for one shared vehicle. Simulated 8 GPS pings on vehicle PQRA265 (id c3c56df0-...), producing 2 overspeed alerts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test flow that works: (1) login demo_web -> dashboard, wait for a[href^='/vehicle/'] before clicking; (2) invite-family-btn shows invite-url-box with data-testid=invite-url; (3) live-tracking-link -> /track/:id; simulate posts 8 sequential requests — WAIT AT LEAST 12-15s after clicking simulate-drive-btn (10s was insufficient in first attempt because 8 sequential axios calls + reload took ~11s). Expect GPS pings=8, speed_alerts=2, current speed=40. (4) Register new user (register-name/email/phone/password testids, then register-submit) auto-logs-in and redirects to /dashboard. (5) Visit invite URL, click accept-invite-btn -> invite-accepted; then /dashboard shows shared-section with shared-card-<plate>. (6) Admin: /admin has admin-alerts-section; alert-type-filter select_option reloads; export-csv-btn triggers download of neksaathi-alerts-<days>d.csv.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues. Note: intermittent flakiness only if simulate reload race is not awaited long enough.
